title: Android Wear integration 'Enable Wear Collection Service' doesn't work
symptom: When walking away from the phone or turning the phone off, the watch does not connect directly to the miaomiao and run xDrip standalone; the watch face keeps incrementing the last reading text, showing no new readings are made.
evidence_quote: When I walk away from my phone, or turn my phone off, I expect my watch to connect directly to the miaomiao, and then run xDrip standalone from the watch -- this doesn't happen.
